name: Still Water
author: byo-pop
description: A game mode to unwind on a pond: a diamond of 60 cells, where any two neighbouring gems may swap, a match or not, at no cost, and in Normal a board with no moves plays on, so the game never ends; leave it when you like. The gems fall down, then up, after each move that matches, which sets off many cascades, under a dusk sky with the sounds a little lower. In Timed the clock still runs. Uses its own high-score table.
